correctness.rationale: The fixed Hamiltonian LCF presentation has 18 vertices, 27 edges, 54 distinct forbidden induced length-two path triples. Independent exhaustive tests of all 2^18 masks using a separate induced-component predicate recover 20651 nonempty faces. Reconstructed vertex-toggle matching has 10320 pairs and exactly one critical vertex, nine critical five-faces and one critical six-face. Complete 120222-incidence topological sort proves acyclicity. Independently computed exact signed integral Morse boundary of the remaining 6-cell against all nine 5-cells is the zero vector. The 4-connected wedge of nine five-spheres has pi_5 isomorphic to Z^9 by Hurewicz, so its null attaching map yields wedge^9 S^5 wedge S^6 integrally. No extrapolation beyond the Pappus graph.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Two-independence is the same as the 3-path-free vertex-complex, but tree-only theorems of Sawant and complete-multipartite-only theorems of Deshpande-Goyal-Sawant do not apply to the cubic girth-six Pappus graph. Published Pappus ordinary matching and ordinary independence complexes are different functors. Indexed searches of Levi graph/Pappus and higher independence did not disclose an equivalent calculation, with genuine uninspected-literature risk.
